summary: 合同收费模板/生效条款只读快照与结算核对首片 on BASE 6ddb951. Added pmo_plugins/contracts/terms_snapshot_services.py with two read-only interfaces. approved_terms_snapshot(member, *, contract_id, as_of=None) returns the contract ref/status/termination marker, the approved-or-historical version ref selected by as_of (approved version effective on/before as_of, latest approved fallback), its effective date, pricing template codes, up to 200 contract lines with template/amounts/active payment+warranty term breakdown and terms total, a change-history summary (change ref/type/status/requested_on, recorded effective_on, before/after version refs), and PM summary_only/settlement_guard flags; each line prefers the existing approval_services.approved_terms_snapshot named read and falls back to a read-only historical projection (readable=false with a reason) when termination/history/amount guards reject. terms_settlement_issues(member, *, as_of=None) returns read-only reconciliation anomalies with issue_code/contract_ref/refs/expected/actual: terms_amount_mismatch (active term total != line gross), settlement_partition_mismatch (active settlement gross != open-item partition total), settlement_terms_mismatch (frozen selected terms total != settlement gross), terms_unapproved_referenced, stale_version_referenced (settlement references a superseded version), line_repeated_consumption (multiple active settlements on one line), cross_project_reference, cross_org_reference, terminated_still_settled (active settlement on/after termination date), and old_terms_still_active (superseded-version lines still have active terms). Permissions are owner/finance/auditor full, PM only managed projects with summary_only=true, member denied, cross-tenant/unknown denied; the new history_read route contract-terms-snapshot keeps the historical page readable after the contracts module is disabled, rejects unknown query parameters and has no POST/write entry. No model, migration, canonical topic/command/schema, contracts/settlement write path or business fact changed; no audit/receipt/event side effect is written (the optional generic viewed audit was deliberately skipped to keep reads pure). Amounts stay integer cents; template codes follow the PH-214 delivery (fixed_milestone/confirmed_time/fixed_service_period) rather than the legacy wording in the spec.

findings: AS_OF/VERSION SEMANTICS VERIFIED AT f42f7c7: `_snapshot_version` selects only approved/superseded versions with effective_on <= as_of, takes the latest version_no/id, and rejects (ValidationError -> page 400) when as_of predates every effective version instead of silently showing the current/future version; a regression now asserts the rejection. With as_of=None it uses the latest approved (falling back to an approved version only when no historical selection exists), and the change summary uses recorded effective_on (new version effective_on for approved non-termination, contract.terminated_on for termination).

READ-ONLY/AGGREGATION/TERMINATION: approved_terms_snapshot and terms_settlement_issues only read Contract/ContractVersion/ContractLine/PaymentTerm/WarrantyTerm/Settlement/OpenItem; no audit/receipt/event/business-fact write, no lock, no settlement write; the line read prefers the existing approval_services.approved_terms_snapshot and falls back to a read-only historical projection with readable=false + reason on termination/history/amount guard rejection. Terms totals use active payment+warranty terms; template codes match PH-214's actual fixed_milestone/confirmed_time/fixed_service_period (spec's legacy fixed_price/time_and_material/service_period wording is correctly not implemented; report discloses); lines truncate at 200; issues cover terms_amount_mismatch, settlement_partition_mismatch, settlement_terms_mismatch, terms_unapproved_referenced, stale_version_referenced, line_repeated_consumption, cross_project_reference, cross_org_reference, terminated_still_settled and old_terms_still_active with contract_ref/refs/expected/actual. The termination test asserts snapshot terminated/unreadable and late active settlement flagged plus the existing settlement guard rejecting new settlement with zero half-writes.

PERMISSIONS/HISTORY/WRITES: owner/finance/auditor full, pm only managed projects with summary_only=true, member denied, cross-tenant/unknown denied; the route contract-terms-snapshot is history_read so the page remains readable after contracts module disablement, unknown query parameters and invalid/future as_of/unknown contract return 400, and there is no POST/write entry. deviations: 模板代码采用 PH-214 实际交付的 fixed_milestone/confirmed_time/fixed_service_period（spec 文字中的 fixed_price/time_and_material/service_period 为旧命名），快照返回实际代码与中文标签，report 披露。
可选的 generic audit `contracts.terms_snapshot.viewed` 未写：保持只读接口零审计副作用；由既有 audit 链覆盖合同/结算写路径，report/handoff 披露。
历史/终止/金额守卫拒绝时，快照行回退为只读投影并 readable=false+unreadable_reason，仍展示历史条款供核对；不修改条款状态或终止守卫。
old_terms_still_active 按 spec 反例“变更后旧条款仍 active”对 superseded 版本仍 active 的条款行报告异常；这是对既有数据结构的只读对账口径，不自动关闭旧条款。
PM 权限实现为“仅其管理项目 + summary_only=true”，仍返回其项目条款摘要；member 拒绝、跨租户/未知拒绝。
as_of 语义：快照只选择 effective_on <= as_of 的批准/历史版本；若该日期没有任何生效版本则拒绝（ValidationError/页面 400），不回退展示未来版本。
